description: Examines a family moving from the Russian Empire to Königsberg; the friendships with Hilbert and Hurwitz; the Paris Academy prize and Henry Smith's earlier work; university life in Bonn, Zürich and Göttingen; the geometry of numbers; teaching, marriage and children; and the geometric form of special relativity.
